title: AI-Assisted Translation of Outpatient Clinical Reports into Plain Language: Development and Pilot Testing of a New Method
summary:
The Geriatric Assessment and Fall Clinic (GISA) is an outpatient service of the Agaplesion Bethesda Clinic Ulm and the Institute for Geriatric Research at Ulm University Hospital. Older patients receive comprehensive geriatric and fall-preventive care based on specialized assessments and diagnostic tests to evaluate individual fall risk. Subsequent treatment includes various recommended interventions, the clear communication of which is essential for patients’ ability to implement them and to maintain independence in daily life.

Within this project, an AI-based application built on a Large Language Model (LLM) is used to translate physician-authored outpatient clinical reports into plain, easy-to-understand language. The aim is to improve adherence to recommended interventions and to strengthen patient autonomy by enabling better understanding of medical information and supporting informed decision-making.

The intervention consists of providing this simplified AI-generated version of the clinical report in addition to standard care, while the control group receives usual care without this additional translation. Effectiveness is primarily evaluated based on adherence to recommendations (compliance) and secondarily on fall incidence and patient satisfaction. These outcomes are assessed through telephone follow-up interviews at 3 and 12 months after the outpatient visit. In addition, barriers to implementation are explored using open-ended questions and analyzed using qualitative methods. All data are stored in pseudonymized form and analyzed using appropriate statistical methods.

interventions.name: The intervention consists of providing an LLM-generated translation, while the control group receives standard care without this additional translation. The intervention is delivered in addition to usual care.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Treatment in the Geriatric Assessment and Fall Clinic (GISA)
Exclusion criteria:
Not capable of giving informed consent, e.g., due to dementia.
